packageRules.description: Add a warning to lock file maintenance pull requests. The package manager selects the new versions, and Renovate cannot read their release dates.
prBodyNotes:
> [!WARNING]
> Renovate cannot check the release dates of the versions that lock file maintenance selects, so the minimum release age (the wait time after a release) cannot protect this update. The lock file can contain new versions that were released less than `minimumReleaseAge` ago. Before you merge, look at the new versions in the lock file.
